prompts.hip: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce exactly SIX anatomically valid inbetween drawings of the same approved cat strictly BETWEEN image1 and image2, as 3 columns by 2 rows sprite sheet. Each full cat fully inside its cell with transparent background, no text or decoration. Preserve exact adult fat body size, short thick legs, silver fur, blue ornaments, single gold horn, closed sleepy eyes and thin dark ink contours. No new pose variation unrelated to endpoints. Head left and tail right always. One continuous ribcage-abdomen-pelvis, shoulder AND hips rotate together. Exactly two short forelegs curl over left chest and two bent hind legs on RIGHT rooted at right hip, never a detached foot in center belly or spare forepaw under face. Maintain all limb identities and visibility; an occluded foot remains hidden until body uncovers it. All six frames are small successive steps, not copies of the endpoints. Focus: image1 hind knees are at right hip with paw BACKS facing camera. Image2 shows the pink rear soles after rolling. Draw the intermediate rotation of whole pelvis, near bent thigh and short shank: fur back -> edge view -> a little toe pad -> full sole. Far hind leg emerges from behind, do not teleport a second pad onto upper back. Belly and haunch stay a SINGLE continuous anatomical volume. Forepaws remain close together on chest; do not extend an extra leg from hair.
